description: This file defines Portuguese (Brazil) language translations for the Summernote WYSIWYG editor, extending the language options with localized labels for UI elements such as fonts, images, videos, links, tables, styles, lists, options, paragraphs, colors, shortcuts, help, history, and special characters.

methods.name: $.extend
methods.description: Method used to extend or merge objects, here used to add language translations to $.summernote.lang.
